top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, independently confirmed arc from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic action of GLP-1(7-36) amide to replicated outcome benefit in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. The citation ties the discovery of the physiology and active form to incretin-based therapy without crediting drug design. The attribution of the active peptide (Mojsov versus Habener) and the omission of Knudsen are real judgment calls, but they do not outweigh the maturity and impact of the achievement, so an award is preferable to no award.
